mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS application_id, a.candidate_id, c.full_name AS candidate_name, c.email AS candidate_email, a.status, a.applied_at, a.status_changed_at, cv.parse_status AS cv_parse_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_notes n WHERE n.application_id = a.id AND n.is_deleted = FALSE) AS notes_count, a.transferred_from_id FROM applications a JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id LEFT JOIN cvs cv ON cv.id = a.cv_id WHERE a.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.is_deleted = FALSE AND c.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY a.status_changed_at DESC, a.id DESC
